visual_review.reviewer: Coding agent visual inspection of the actual captured PNG
observations: Bonsai displays the imported two-storey model in User Orthographic view with three visible slab planes, columns, beams, walls and hosted frames.
Front door apertures and front/side window openings remain visible; the selected upper side window is outlined in orange.
Project Info displays Types_Quantities_Workbench.ifc and IFC4; the spatial panel reports 33 elements.
No error dialog, blank viewport or missing building storey is visible. Material layer identity and SI thickness are established by the numeric IFC checks, not inferred from viewport colors.
visual_review.limits: One synthetic fixture and one camera view on this Linux application build; no Windows acceptance, general IFC compatibility, or independent geometry kernel claim.
